name: Phosphor Gate
description: Edge gates for the scrolling strip in the official Phosphor style. Columns arriving on screen materialize through a cyan energize gate at the leading edge, and columns leaving drain to a dark navy silhouette with a rose afterglow at the trailing edge. The gates breathe in with scroll speed and never touch the middle of the screen. Everything settles to the plain strip the instant scrolling stops.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Response Speed
parameters.description: Scroll speed at which the edge gates reach half strength. Lower values make the gates light up on gentler scrolls.

parameters.name: Gate Depth
parameters.description: How far each edge gate reaches inward at full scroll speed, as a fraction of the strip's work area width.

parameters.name: Glow Intensity
parameters.description: Brightness of the gradient glow where content crosses the gates.

parameters.name: Unlit Dim
parameters.description: How dark content goes while it is still materializing at the arrival edge or draining out at the departure edge.

parameters.name: Afterglow Trail
parameters.description: Length of the rose afterglow that departing content leaves at the trailing edge.

parameters.name: Gate Meander
parameters.description: How raggedly the gate boundary wavers. Zero gives a straight vertical gate.

parameters.name: Meander Grain
parameters.description: Vertical scale of the gate waver. Higher values give finer ripples.

parameters.name: Ember Sparks
parameters.description: Strength of the small sparks that feed arriving content through the gate.

parameters.name: Ember Density
parameters.description: How many rows of ember sparks the arrival gate carries. More rows also means smaller sparks, since each one is sized to its row.

parameters.name: Edge Feather
parameters.description: How softly the effect fades at the edges of the strip work area.
